unifiedExplanation.source: Verify your RSS feed, review the registration and sign with your creator wallet. Keryx covers gas while its sponsorship wallet has enough funds. You keep control and receive creator payments.
unifiedExplanation.text: 验证 RSS 订阅源，审阅注册并使用创作者钱包签名。只要赞助钱包资金充足，Keryx 就承担 gas。您保留控制权并接收创作者付款。

verificationExplanation.source: Publish a proof on your website or in your RSS feed. Verification alone does not enable paid distribution.
verificationExplanation.text: 在网站或 RSS 订阅源中发布证明。仅完成验证不会启用付费分发。

feedRequired.source: Include your exact HTTPS RSS feed before creating the ownership proof.
feedRequired.text: 创建所有权证明前，请填写确切的 HTTPS RSS 订阅源。

draftNetworkMismatch.source: This draft belongs to another network. Return to that network or start a new draft.
draftNetworkMismatch.text: 此草稿属于其他网络。请返回该网络或开始新草稿。

draftOwnerMismatch.source: This draft belongs to another wallet. Sign in with its creator wallet or start a new draft.
draftOwnerMismatch.text: 此草稿属于其他钱包。使用其创作者钱包登录或开始新草稿。

indexedPolicyUnavailable.source: Your registration is indexed, but its verified ownership link is not yet available. Reload the source policy before continuing.
indexedPolicyUnavailable.text: 注册已建立索引，但经验证的所有权关联尚不可用。继续前请重新加载来源政策。

reloadIndexedPolicy.text: 重新加载已验证来源政策

policyReviewExplanation.source: Your listing is registered. Choose its earnings policy below; paid distribution still needs your explicit permission.
policyReviewExplanation.text: 条目已注册。在下方选择收益政策；付费分发仍需要您的明确许可。

sponsorshipFundsUnavailable.source: New sponsored registrations are paused because available gas funds are insufficient. Existing covered requests can still be completed within their reservation.
sponsorshipFundsUnavailable.text: 可用 gas 资金不足，因此新的赞助注册已暂停。现有已获覆盖请求仍可在其预留额度内完成。

walletFundedExplanation.source: Prefer to pay the transaction gas yourself? Keep this source draft and use wallet-funded registration.
walletFundedExplanation.text: 希望自行支付交易 gas？保留此来源草稿并使用钱包出资注册。

pageHeading.text: 使用赞助 gas 发布

pageExplanation.source: Prove control of your RSS feed, review its terms, then sign the registration. Keryx covers gas while sponsorship funds are available. Your wallet keeps control and receives creator payments.
pageExplanation.text: 证明您对 RSS 订阅源的控制权，审阅条款，然后签署注册。只要赞助资金可用，Keryx 就承担 gas。钱包保留控制权并接收创作者付款。

invitationHeading.text: 注册 gas 由 Keryx 承担

invitationExplanation.source: Verify control of your feed, review the source terms and sign. You keep source management and payouts.
invitationExplanation.text: 验证订阅源控制权，审阅来源条款并签名。您保留来源管理权和收款权。

stateLabels.submitted.text: 原始交易已提交：等待确认

recoveryUnavailable.source: Original recovery is unavailable. Keep this request; do not register again.
recoveryUnavailable.text: 原始恢复不可用。请保留此请求；不要再次注册。

originalWalletMismatch.source: Original registration belongs to another wallet or registry
originalWalletMismatch.text: 原始注册属于其他钱包或注册合约

verifyConnectedWallet.source: Verify this source with the connected wallet first
verifyConnectedWallet.text: 先使用已连接钱包验证此来源

originalClaimMismatch.source: Original registration belongs to another source claim
originalClaimMismatch.text: 原始注册属于其他来源认领

savedRecoveryUnavailable.source: Saved original recovery is unavailable; retain its ID.
savedRecoveryUnavailable.text: 已保存原始恢复不可用；请保留其 ID。

waitForExpiry.source: Wait until the original unsigned request has conclusively expired.
waitForExpiry.text: 等待原始未签名请求明确过期。

saveRequestBeforeSigning.source: Save the original request ID below before signing. Browser recovery storage is unavailable.
saveRequestBeforeSigning.text: 签名前请保存下方原始请求 ID。浏览器恢复存储不可用。

preparedTermsMismatch.source: The prepared registration does not match this source and selected price. Review the original request before signing.
preparedTermsMismatch.text: 已准备注册与此来源及所选价格不符。签名前请审阅原始请求。

signingAllowanceUnavailable.source: This original has no current signing allowance. Inspect its status; do not register again.
signingAllowanceUnavailable.text: 此原始请求当前没有签名额度。检查其状态；不要再次注册。

submissionUnknown.source: Submission unknown. Inspect the original request.
submissionUnknown.text: 提交结果未知。请检查原始请求。

connectInstructions.source: Connect and sign in with your creator wallet on ${network}.
connectInstructions.text: 在 ${network} 上连接创作者钱包并登录。

sponsorshipUnavailable.source: Registration gas sponsorship is currently unavailable for this wallet. Existing requests can still be inspected.
sponsorshipUnavailable.text: 此钱包目前无法获得注册 gas 赞助。仍可检查现有请求。

verifyFeedInstructions.source: Prove control of your exact feed first.
verifyFeedInstructions.text: 先证明您对确切订阅源的控制权。

indexedHeading.text: 注册已确认并完成索引

retainedFeedContent.text: Keryx 留存的订阅源内容

gasReservation.source: Keryx gas reservation: up to ${gasUsdc} USDC. This is separate from creator earnings.
gasReservation.text: Keryx gas 预留：最多 ${gasUsdc} USDC。此额度与创作者收入分开。

confirmedGasCost.text: 已确认的赞助方 gas 成本：${gasUsdc} USDC

expiredRequestExplanation.source: This original expired before sponsor signing. A new reviewed request uses another sponsorship attempt and retains the original history.
expiredRequestExplanation.text: 此原始请求在赞助方签名前已过期。新的已审阅请求使用另一次赞助尝试，并保留原始历史。

requestRecoveryUnavailable.source: Original recovery unavailable; retain this request.
requestRecoveryUnavailable.text: 原始恢复不可用；请保留此请求。

resumeOriginalExplanation.source: Resume uses the original creator authorization, transaction nonce and gas limits. A retained signed transaction is sent again unchanged. It does not register a new attempt or increase the gas reservation.
resumeOriginalExplanation.text: 继续操作使用原始创作者授权、交易 nonce 和 gas 限额。留存的已签名交易将原样再次发送。它不会登记新的尝试或增加 gas 预留额度。

resolveExpiredButton.source: Resolve expired original using reserved gas
resolveExpiredButton.text: 使用预留 gas 处理已过期原始交易

resolveExpiredExplanation.source: After authorization expires, you may explicitly finish the original transaction. Keryx pays its gas within the existing reservation; the registration must revert. Inspect its receipt before preparing a new attempt. This creates no source and increases no spending limit.
resolveExpiredExplanation.text: 授权过期后，您可以明确完成原始交易。Keryx 在现有预留额度内支付 gas；注册必须回滚。准备新尝试前请检查凭证。此操作不创建来源，也不增加支出限额。

revertedRequestExplanation.source: The original transaction reverted and its actual gas was charged. A new reviewed registration consumes another attempt within the same allowance and retains the original history.
revertedRequestExplanation.text: 原始交易已回滚，实际 gas 已收费。新的已审阅注册在同一额度内消耗另一次尝试，并保留原始历史。

publisherScope.source: Gas sponsorship is limited to verified publishers at: ${publishers}.
publisherScope.text: gas 赞助仅限以下已验证发布者：${publishers}。

feedUrlExplanation.source: For sponsored feed registration, include your exact HTTPS feed on the same website before creating the ownership proof.
feedUrlExplanation.text: 使用赞助订阅源注册时，创建所有权证明前请填写同一网站上的确切 HTTPS 订阅源。

feedOriginUnavailable.source: Use a full HTTPS feed URL on the same publisher origin.
feedOriginUnavailable.text: 使用同一发布者源上的完整 HTTPS 订阅源 URL。

lostResponseExplanation.source: A lost response retains this attempt. Inspection sends no new transaction. Registration alone does not activate creator earnings.
lostResponseExplanation.text: 响应丢失时仍保留此次尝试。检查不会发送新交易。仅完成注册不会启用创作者收益。

earningsPolicyLink.text: 审阅此来源的收益政策 ▸

idRecoveryUnavailable.source: Original recovery unavailable; retain its ID.
idRecoveryUnavailable.text: 原始恢复不可用；请保留其 ID。

priceOnlyUpdateExplanation.source: Price updates change only the price. A concurrent edit requires a fresh review before signing.
priceOnlyUpdateExplanation.text: 价格更新仅更改价格。并发编辑需要在签名前重新审阅。

legacyPriceUpdateExplanation.source: Price updates also submit these fields. Avoid editing this source elsewhere while the wallet prompt is open.
legacyPriceUpdateExplanation.text: 价格更新还会提交这些字段。钱包提示打开期间，请避免在其他地方编辑此来源。
